headline: Nvidia reports record quarterly revenue and profit, unveiling a new strategic bet on AI-driven computing.
Euro zone inflation climbs above 3% in latest reading, strengthening expectations of an ECB rate hike.
U.S. two-year Treasury yield rose to its highest level since 2025, deepening a global bond sell‑off and pushing yields higher across major markets.
Two oil supertankers were struck by unknown projectiles while transiting the Strait of Hormuz, raising concerns over Middle East tensions and oil flow disruptions.
London Stock Exchange partners with Payward to tokenise major UK stocks on‑chain
Cronos validators purge transaction history to contain $75 million lending protocol exploit, network pause leaves restart timetable unknown
Amazon denies FTC lawsuit claims it rigged $20 bn in ad prices, saying the agency misread its ad market.
Russian drone and missile barrage on Kyiv kills at least 12, prompting EU defence ministers in Ireland to discuss Ukraine's air‑defence shortages.
Fed Governor Barr says he would support a rate hike if inflation does not ease, warning of broader price pressures taking hold.
Citi, Goldman Sachs and other major banks and asset managers announce a joint stablecoin venture
Robinhood launches a new crypto network that generates cash flow, sending Arbitrum's token sharply higher
Cross-chain oracle breach triggers widespread liquidations, vault freezes on Full Sail, Virtue, Volo, while Sui and IOTA stay operational.
Google launches Google Pics, an AI‑driven design tool that creates graphics from text prompts, challenging Canva and Adobe.
🇺🇸🇮🇷 US military says it has begun striking targets in Iran, according to CENTCOM.
